info.title: Peek API
info.description: Same-origin API used by the Peek PWA for French and Swiss parcels with Supabase Auth. Every private operation is scoped to the bearer-token owner.

requirements.label: Planzer tracking URL
requirements.help: Paste the complete shared link, including its accessKey.

requirements.label: Dachser tracking URL
requirements.help: Paste the complete public detail link, including its access parameters.

requirements.label: Delivery postcode
requirements.help: GLS uses the recipient postcode to unlock the detailed event history.

requirements.label: Delivery postcode
requirements.help: Optional. DPD uses it to unlock verified scans and the delivery window.

requirements.label: Delivery postcode
requirements.help: Short Mondial Relay shipment numbers require the recipient postcode; validated 26-digit label barcodes do not.

requirements.label: Delivery postcode
requirements.help: Heppner uses the recipient postcode to verify the shipment in France or Switzerland.

requirements.label: Delivery postcode
requirements.help: Paack requires the recipient postcode together with the order number.

requirements.label: Delivery postcode
requirements.help: GLS requires the four- or five-digit delivery postcode to show the detailed event history.

204.description: Off, also when the link or the browser had no such alert

get.summary: The link the signed-in account shares this parcel through

200.description: The live link, or null when the parcel is not shared

put.summary: Share this parcel: makes its link when none is live, else changes what the live one shows

204.description: Not shared, also when it was not shared before

supabaseBearer.description: Access token from the signed-in Supabase Auth session.

recognized.description: Carriers that each know the number when no single one could be picked; the user chooses.

asked.description: Carriers recognition asked about the number, best first. Absent when the number's shape left none to ask.

unanswered.description: Asked carriers that failed or ran out of time; their answer is unknown, not a no.

EventPlace.description: Where a scan happened, located on the server from its free-text location.

precision.description: country when the scan names only its country; the point is then the country's label point.

name.description: The town: the carrier's own spelling when it has one, else the gazetteer name.

site.description: The facility the point is on, when it has a name of its own ("Zürich-Mülligen"). Shown where there is room; name stays the town.

place.description: Null when the location names no place the server can trust.

sync_error.description: User-facing tracking failure code (carrier:<kind>) when available; legacy diagnostic text otherwise. Clients must not display raw diagnostic text.

dpd_postcode.description: Canonical recipient postcode used by DPD and GLS Switzerland, Mondial Relay, Heppner or Paack. Paack postcodes are stored uppercase without spaces; the database field keeps its historical name for API compatibility.

active_tracking_number.description: Verified delivery-leg tracking number when the carrier changes.

tracking_provider.description: Universal provider that supplied the displayed tracking result, cleared on direct recovery.

carrier_answered.description: The parcel's own carrier answered the same check, but its newest scan had no time zone, so a universal provider supplied the result. Links still go to the carrier.

sender_name.description: Verified sender name, retained when a tracking response omits sender details.

dpd_postcode_verified.description: False when DPD rejected the stored delivery postcode and the lookup continued without it.

destination_country.description: Destination country the carrier reported, when it did.

routing.description: Server routing state; clients read only the fields listed here.

input_needed.description: A carrier that knows the tracking number but needs the listed input before it can track the parcel.

trackingNumber.description: Normalizes to an uppercase alphanumeric tracking number between 4 and 40 characters and containing at least one digit.

trackingUrl.description: Required for Planzer shared-link and Dachser shipments. These capability URLs are private credentials.

dpdPostcode.description: Recipient postcode, optional for DPD Switzerland (four digits; it unlocks verified scans) and required by GLS Switzerland (four digits), GLS Germany and Heppner (four or five digits), Mondial Relay short shipment numbers (five digits; optional for validated 26-digit barcodes) and Paack (carrier-specific alphanumeric format). It is rejected for other carriers. This property keeps its historical name for API compatibility.

trackingUrl.description: Required for Planzer shared-link and Dachser shipments. These capability URLs are private credentials.

dpdPostcode.description: Recipient postcode, optional for DPD Switzerland and required by GLS Switzerland, GLS Germany, Mondial Relay short shipment numbers, Heppner or Paack.

packageId.description: Present when a package creation conflict identifies the existing owned parcel.

scope.description: Present on a 429 when the day's lookups without an account are used up; signing in lifts the limit.

previewId.description: Random invitation key used in standalone short links. May be submitted as code to preview, accept, or revoke the invitation.

invitationState.description: Account-specific outcome of preview_invite or accept_invite. No new friendship was created.

previousInviteCount.description: Number of still-active invitations created before the returned invitation. Visible only to their owner.

ParcelLink.description: A capability link to one parcel, as its caller may use it.

role.description: owner when the request carried the link's owner key.

kind.description: lookup: made without an account. shared: belongs to an account.

forgetAt.description: When the lookup is forgotten as things stand; null for a shared link.

numberShown.description: False when the tracking number is masked for this role.

canKeep.description: Whether the caller may keep the parcel after signing in: the owner, or a viewer of a link that shows its number.

gift.description: A gift link. Until the parcel is delivered a viewer gets no sender, a masked number, and the scans of the origin reduced to "Left the sender" and a country. Always sent; an answer stored on a device before sharing existed lacks it.

shared.description: False once the owner stopped the sharing: only the owner still reads the link. Always sent.

ParcelNumberHint.description: The ends of a masked tracking number: up to four leading and three trailing characters, fewer for a short number.

PublicPackage.description: A parcel as a link shows it: PackageRow's fields, without anything private to an account.

tracking_number.description: Null when masked for the caller; number_hint then carries its ends.

label.description: Always empty: a name stays on the device that chose it.

created_at.description: When the parcel was first followed, never earlier than the link.

sync_error.description: A tracking failure code (carrier:<kind>) or null; diagnostic text is never sent.

tracking_url.description: Always null: a stored link is a private credential.

carrier_data.description: The carrier details a link may show. Every other stored key stays on the server.

active_tracking_number.description: Only when the number is shown.

original_tracking_number.description: Only when the number is shown.

trackingNumber.description: Normalizes to an uppercase alphanumeric tracking number between 4 and 40 characters and containing at least one digit.

trackingUrl.description: Required for Planzer shared-link and Dachser shipments. These capability URLs are private credentials.

dpdPostcode.description: Recipient postcode, for the carriers that take one; see CreatePackageRequest.

key.description: The owner key. Returned this once; the server keeps only its hash.
The owner key, when this device made the lookup.

label.description: The name the parcel had on the device.

outcome.description: kept: now in the box. already: the number was there. quota: the box is full. unavailable: unknown link, or no right to keep it.

packageId.description: The parcel in the box, for kept and already.

ParcelAlerts.description: Whether this server sends browser notifications for a link, and the key a browser subscribes with.

UpdateParcelLinkRequest.description: What to change; a value left out stays as it is.

showNumber.description: Whether viewers see the whole tracking number.

shared.description: False stops the sharing; true resumes it.

ParcelAlertPreset.description: What an alert announces: every scan, the important steps (the account preset of that name), or out for delivery and delivered only.

ParcelAlertSubscription.description: The browser's push subscription, as PushSubscription.toJSON() gives it.

ParcelShare.description: The link an account shares one of its parcels through. The parcel's name is not part of it: the client adds it after # in the address it copies.

ShareParcelRequest.description: What the link shows; a value left out stays as it is, and is false on a new link.
